items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: when you joined, after the war, you joined Sid Leprotti's band. ... Yes.

ctx.x: Yeah, somebody told me the other day, I don't know who it was, it doesn't make any difference, but you've been here ever since 1912. No, they got to mix up.

I came here in 1915, and I didn't go back with them. I lived in Los Angeles all that time. Then when I got discharged here in San Francisco, I had a job over here, they used to call it the Barber Coast. Now they call it the International. Yeah. So I worked over there with another old guy from New Orleans. He never did go back. He might have left there in 1912. His name is Sid Leprotti.
Oh, yeah. Did Sid Leprotti come from New Orleans? That's his hometown.
